instructions: Put the 4 eggs in a saucepan and cover them with cold water by about 1 inch. Set the pan on high heat and bring it to a rolling boil.
Take the pan off the heat, cover it, and let the eggs sit for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, tear the lettuce into bite-size pieces, wash it, and spin it dry. That should be about 8 cups. Transfer it into a large bowl.
Transfer the eggs into a bowl of ice water and let them chill while you cut everything else.
Thinly slice a quarter of the red onion. Halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the cucumber until you have 1 cup.
Cut the ham and turkey into 1/2 inch strips. Cut the cheddar into 1/2 inch cubes.
Peel the eggs and cut each into wedges.
Arrange the ham, turkey, cheddar, eggs, onion, tomatoes and cucumber over the lettuce, in rows or in sections.
Pour the ranch into a small bowl and serve it with the salad.
method_notes: No source had 20 ratings: Spend With Pennies (5.0 from 16) leads and Baked Bree and Well Plated agree on the same build of greens, ham, turkey, cheese, eggs and vegetables. Baked Bree's 1/4 cup of ranch is the only source amount for the dressing, so it is doubled here for four plates. For gluten-free, check the deli meats and the ranch label, and leave out the croutons Well Plated adds. RecipeTin Eats has no chef salad, so the fallback is the best-rated version read.
